subject: SYSTEMIC: All consecutive exam pairs exceed 40% answer overlap
body:
GR: cross-exam-answer-overlap audit reveals ALL 10 consecutive RP pairs exceed the 40% threshold:

- RP1/RP2: 60.0%
- RP2/RP3: 55.0%
- RP3/RP4: 45.0%
- RP4/RP5: 54.5%
- RP5/RP6: 54.5%
- RP6/RP7: 72.0%
- RP7/RP8: 81.5%
- RP8/RP9: 74.1%
- RP9/RP10: 60.7%
- RP10/RP11: 44.8%

This is systemic. GP filed the RP8/RP9 bug -- I am now confirming it spans all exams.

Action needed from GR: diversify answer values across all RP exams. At minimum, consecutive pairs should share no more than 40% of numeric answers. Priority: RP6/RP7 (72%) and RP7/RP8 (81.5%) are worst.

I have created the audit test at tests/f-validation/cross-exam-answer-overlap.test.js. It is NOT committed as a blocking CI test (would fail immediately). Once GR fixes the data, I can enable it as a gate.

GA
